sources.title: The Dummy models of Scikit-learn - Towards Data Science
sources.snippet: If your actual model gives worse results than this very, very simple approach, you might want to review your model. Dummy models in scikit-learn The dummy model package of scikit-learn is pretty simple: it only consists of 2 classes: a DummyClassifier a DummyRegressor The scikit-learn API docs for the dummy module is quite simple.
